problem: The wallet UI hangs for 30 s when a peer is unreachable (#470), and one late reply fails a whole call with Timeout.
why_needed: Issue #470: the wallet UI hung for 30 s on unreachable peers, and short outages reach wallet users as “offline”.
what_it_gives: A call is tried up to 3 times and a dead peer is noticed after 5 s instead of 30 s, so one late reply no longer shows the wallet as offline.

related_work.overlap: Adds retry in HttpTransport, one layer lower. If both merge, one call can make up to 9 attempts.
“Wallet UI hangs 30 s”. Asks for a shorter wait; does not ask for retry.
Adopts this retry API and still calls send_once(), which this PR removes.

fit_questions.question: Right layer? Retry sits in RpcClient while #479 adds it in HttpTransport; should there be only one?
Oversized for the problem? #470 is about the wait time; would the timeout change in src/config.rs:23 alone fix it?
Duplicates an existing mechanism? sync::retry_headers already loops on failure; does header sync now retry inside a retry?
